description: Use for 'how is crypto taxed in X' — e.g. 'is crypto tax-free in Portugal', 'Germany 1-year holding rule', 'crypto capital gains in UAE', 'do I pay tax selling bitcoin in Slovakia'. Give the country (ISO-3166 code or English name). Returns the country's crypto tier, summary, effective individual rate, capital gains, income tax on crypto, corporate tax, VAT, and supporting details, with data_as_of and sources. For two-country crypto comparisons use tax_compare.

country.description: Country to look up: ISO-3166 alpha-2/alpha-3 code or English name, e.g. 'DE', 'DEU', 'Germany'.
